title: Quarter hypothesis index: Private/VPC/on-prem roadmap with measurable acceptance & sprint commitments
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact, hypothesis-indexed quarterly roadmap for Private (VPC / on-prem) that ties each initiative to a measurable acceptance signal, sprint-level commitments, and rollback/compatibility gates. This ticket captures the PM-side synthesis and team commitments required to move from strategic objectives to sprint-level scope for Q2 2026.

Scope: Top-level initiatives for the quarter across Private control plane, on-prem packaging, KMS/HSM integrations, and upgrade/compatibility automation. For each initiative we will: (1) state the business hypothesis; (2) identify the primary success metric and guardrail metrics; (3) map to OKRs; (4) capture owner and required engineering/design work; (5) commit to sprint milestones and acceptance criteria; (6) list pilot customers and rollout constraints.

Goals:
- Reduce private-deploy time-to-first-success for pilot customers by 30% (guide-level).
- Prove seamless upgrade path for on-prem customers across minor runtime versions with <= 1% incident rate in pilot cohort.
- Deliver first-class KMS key rotation flow with audit events for two enterprise customers in pilot.

Deliverables:
- Hypothesis index (top 6 hypotheses) with ranked certainty and required experiments.
- Sprint commitments for next 6 sprints (names, owners, acceptance criteria).
- OKR mapping doc snippet and dashboard signal definitions.
- Pilot onboarding checklist and rollback triggers.
- Risk register and mitigation plans for each initiative.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Hypothesis index published and reviewed by Eng/Design/Security.
2) Each hypothesis has at least one measurable success metric and a linked dashboard query.
3) Sprint commitments defined for six sprints with owners and estimates.
4) Compatibility gate definitions agreed and documented: upgrade rollback criteria, schema compat checks, and canary size.
5) Two pilot customers identified per initiative with agreed evaluation windows.
6) Cross-functional kickoff scheduled and notes captured in the roadmap doc.
milestones: Draft hypothesis index and metric mapping — 2026-03-18
rollout_plan: Pilot-first rollout. Each initiative runs a two-week pilot with 2 enterprise customers, followed by a canary with 10% of onboarding traffic, then staged ramp. Rollback triggers: >0.5x expected API errors, latency regressions exceeding 2x baseline p95, or any data-leakage audit event. Final GA only after pilot metrics meet success criteria for two consecutive weeks.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Upgrade incompatibilities cause state loss for pilot customers. Mitigation: automated preflight checks, readonly dry-run upgrade in staging, and mandatory snapshot+rollback playbook.
Risk: KMS integration delays due to customer HSM variance. Mitigation: provide a temporary envelope encryption fallback and clear onboarding checklist for HSM vendors.
Risk: Sprint scope creep impacts other Dedicated commitments. Mitigation: lock sprint commitments after cross-functional review and require trade-off approval from Eng Director for scope additions.
